name: Sungbin BYUN
headline: Films about the fragile borders between people.
intro_note: An independent filmmaker working across fiction, identity, family, and the quiet complexities of human connection.
hero_meta: South Korea · 80 min 12 sec · A film by Sungbin BYUN
about_heading: Making films about people at the edges of belonging.
bio_paragraph_1: Sungbin BYUN is a South Korean film director and screenwriter. His work explores identity, disability, gender, family, and the emotional lives of people who are often pushed to the margins.
bio_paragraph_2: His short films have screened at international festivals, including the Clermont-Ferrand International Short Film Festival and the Busan International Film Festival. His debut feature, Peafowl (2022), continued his exploration of identity and belonging.
